capabilityRows.notes: Tencent 3.0.3 TokenHub Chat Completions and Kling video, and TC3-signed Tencent Cloud VOD start/status operations. Native options, lazy independent credentials, media inputs, warnings, errors and billing metadata preserve release-matched scenarios. JavaScript workflows and Zod module lifecycle are excluded; native required prompt adaptation is documented. Each output exposes its own URL/MIME descriptor, including mixed-format VOD results.

release.rationale: New optional SwiftPM provider with complete native language/video surfaces. No preexisting public selectors change. Requires core1.5.0 for per-video URL/MIME descriptors; descriptorless legacy selectors remain unchanged.

knownGaps: JavaScript workflow serialization and lazy Zod module lifecycle are outside the Swift product scope.
Native required prompt uses empty string as omitted upstream prompt.
